02

Philosophy

Why each mode exists and what it's optimized for.

Swing

Timing-sensitive. Catalyst-driven. Regime-gated. ~80% rejection rate by design. Stop is non-negotiable (1.25× ATR). Built around the 2–3 week capture window where momentum is provable and exits are cheap.

Position

Trend strength + sector rotation. No R:R gate, no earnings blackout — designed to ride the multi-month leg, not snipe entries. Weekly EMA stack matters more than daily noise. ~80% pass rate (broad uptrending universe).

Invest

Fundamentals dominate (65% of scoring). Hard quality gates filter out micro-caps and over-leveraged names. Dividend yield valued. Tolerates 20% extension above 200-EMA. Built for the multi-quarter compounding thesis.

Methodology Checklist (5 Booleans)

The Dow / Wyckoff / Elliott / Gann philosophy expressed as 5 PASS/FAIL gates per ticker. ≥3 of 5 = OK to enter, ≥4 = STRONG.
Check Pass condition Source data Implementation note
1. Dow Theory uptrend SPY higher-highs & higher-lows on daily 120d OR weekly 26w SPY close series + auto-resampled weekly analysis.py methodology_checklist · either timeframe = pass
2. Wyckoff markup proxy Price rising over last 10d AND recent volume ≥ 0.9 × 20d avg Daily close + volume Real Wyckoff phase classifier is roadmap gap #1 — proxy for now
3. MA stack Price > 50-day SMA > 200-day SMA Daily close ≥ 200 bars Classical Stage-2 uptrend
4. Sector strength Mapped sector ETF (XLE/XLK/etc.) outperforming = true data_fetcher.get_sector_etf_data (63d window) Inline sector-text → ETF map resolves Energy → XLE etc.
5. No late wave Elliott Wave label NOT in Wave 4 ending or Wave 5 analysis.py:1266 score_elliott_wave Wave 3 = early/mid · Wave 4/5 = late-cycle reversal risk
